'''Anev Xydes''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Adept]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was part of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] team that infiltrated the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in search of an [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]].
